title: The Kadison–Ringrose cohomology conjecture

result.label: The Kadison–Ringrose cohomology conjecture
result.statement: Proves that every bounded Hochschild cocycle of degree at least two on a complex von Neumann algebra, with coefficients in the algebra itself, has a bounded primitive. Equivalently, all higher bounded Hochschild cohomology groups vanish, resolving the Kadison–Ringrose conjecture.
